website.skipped: Pure medtech / diagnostics company — no proprietary therapeutic pipeline page; products are devices, assays, and surgical instruments.

ctgov.note: 2 sponsor-led P2 studies (MammoSite, GliaSite) are COMPLETED legacy device trials. The only RECRUITING P2 (NCT07087419 SHAZAM) is investigator-initiated (University of Washington lead) of generic Tinidazole; Hologic is collaborator only and the asset is not a Hologic proprietary therapeutic — excluded per partner-owned rule.

commercial_product.note: Hologic is a women's health-focused medical device, diagnostics, and surgical company. Major franchises (per FY2025 10-K Overview): Diagnostics (Aptima, Panther / Panther Fusion / Panther Scalable Solution molecular assays, ThinPrep Pap test, Biotheranostics breast-cancer tests), Breast Health (3Dimensions / Genius 3D Mammography, Affirm biopsy, BRevera, SuperSonic Imagine), GYN Surgical (NovaSure, MyoSure, Acessa, Fluent), Skeletal Health (Horizon DXA, Faxitron). All marketed under FDA device pathways (510(k) / PMA), not the IND/NDA P1-P3 drug-development paradigm.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Investigator-initiated (University of Washington lead sponsor); intervention is generic Tinidazole, not a Hologic-owned therapeutic. Hologic participates only as collaborator (likely supplying its Aptima M. genitalium diagnostic assay).

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Pure medical device / molecular diagnostics / surgical instrument company (Diagnostics, Breast Health, GYN Surgical, Skeletal Health). No proprietary drug pipeline. Marketed products follow FDA 510(k)/PMA device pathways.
